❯ Think carefully and write one paragraph about tmux pane ids.

⏺ A tmux pane id is %N — a monotonically increasing integer prefixed with a percent sign, assigned once when the pane is
  created and never reused within a server's lifetime, which makes it the only genuinely stable handle tmux gives you.
